# Structured extraction schema and validation gate

Defines Pydantic models representing the allowed JSON structure for extraction outputs (business rules, features, risks) and exposes SCHEMA via ExtractionOut.model_json_schema(). This set of models constitutes the validation gate that will reject outputs not matching the declared schema.
